sequence_notes.rule: Veo's camera stays locked; Premiere does the push into the lid, eased.
sequence_notes.why: Camera moves make Omni redraw the scene; the 'zoom into the bin lid' is Premiere's.

sequence_notes.rule: The BadCode logo and name are the real logo files, laid onto the lid in Premiere/ffmpeg with a glow, never drawn by Flow.
sequence_notes.why: The logo is not a loose guide.

sequence_notes.rule: Motion prompts are written clean-room after you pick: a sealed writer gets the option's idea and the still, nothing from the repo.
No speech anywhere; sound is the street, the bin wheels, the lid, then a hum as the logo lights.

frames.job: Show the street of signs, and someone taking the bin out like it's any other night.

options.label: The bin goes out
options.idea: The person wheels the green bin down the path to the kerb and walks back in; a car's headlights pass.

lanes.does: Locked camera; the person wheels the bin to the kerb, plastic wheels rattle.
A slow push in toward the bin as it lands at the kerb.

options.cut: Cut to frame 2 as the bin stops.

options.label: Still street, Premiere push
options.idea: No video: the still with a slow push toward the bin, wheel rattle and street sound under it.

lanes.does: Slow push in on the still.

options.risk: No credits; reads as a photo.

frames.job: Pull us in: the bin is where the story goes.

options.label: Rain on the lid, push in to black
options.idea: Raindrops run off the lid and the leaf shivers in the breeze; Premiere pushes hard into the lid until it fills the frame, then the cut to inside.

lanes.does: Locked camera; drips, the leaf trembles, the streetlight flickers once.
Fast eased push into the lid's centre, cut on the darkest frame.

options.cut: Hard cut to frame 3 on black.

options.label: A glow from under the lid
options.idea: A faint light flickers on along the lid's edge, as if something inside switched on; Premiere pushes in toward it.

lanes.does: Locked camera; a thin glow appears under the lid's front lip.

options.cut: Cut to frame 3 as the glow peaks.
options.risk: Medium: Omni may light the whole bin or open the lid.

frames.job: The reveal: BadCode, lit up inside the lid.

options.label: Shut lid, the logo powers on
options.idea: Inside, still and dark; light seams flicker at the lid's edge; the logo and name flicker on in the lid's square panel like a sign warming up, then hold.

lanes.does: Locked camera; the edge light flickers, bags shift slightly.
The real logo and name composited onto the panel with a glow and a flicker-on, light spill on the ribs.

options.label: Post only
options.idea: No video: the still, the logo composited flickering on, a slow push up into it.
